text.hi: Quadratic formula completing the square method se derive hota hai aur yeh har quadratic equation ko solve karne ka sabse powerful tool hai. Isse direct roots mil jaati hain!
text.en: Quadratic formula completing the square method se derive hota hai aur yeh har quadratic equation ko solve karne ka sabse powerful tool hai. Isse direct roots mil jaati hain!

content.hi:
Deriving the Quadratic Formula
Quadratic formula ax² + bx + c = 0 ko completing the square se derive kiya jaata hai:
• ax² + bx + c = 0
• x² + (b/a)x + c/a = 0 (divide by a)
• x² + (b/a)x = -c/a
• x² + (b/a)x + (b/2a)² = -c/a + (b/2a)²
• (x + b/2a)² = (b² - 4ac)/4a²
• x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / 2a

💡 Yeh derivation samajhna important hai kyunki isse formula yaad rehta hai!

content.hi:
The Quadratic Formula
x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / 2a
Yeh formula har quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 ke roots directly deta hai. Bas a, b, c ki values rakh do aur solve kar lo!
Example: x² - 5x + 6 = 0 mein a=1, b=-5, c=6. x = [5 ± √(25-24)]/2 = [5 ± 1]/2 = 3, 2

content.hi:
How to Use the Formula?
Quadratic formula use karne ke steps:
• Step 1: Equation ko standard form (ax² + bx + c = 0) mein likho
• Step 2: a, b, c ki values identify karo
• Step 3: b² - 4ac (discriminant) calculate karo
• Step 4: Formula mein values rakh kar solve karo
• Step 5: ± sign se do roots milenge

💡 Tip: Signs ka dhyan rakhna! Agar b negative hai toh -(-b) = +b hoga.
